description: This file contains the server-side logic for the 'TheoryExam' page in an online examination system. It manages loading questions from the database, handling user responses, navigation controls, and submission logic for theory exam questions.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam.aspx page managing the theory exam process

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the exam page by loading questions from the database based on session data, and sets the timer for the exam.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the course name based on course ID.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Processes the user's submitted answers, storing them in the database and updating related queues.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles timeout condition.
